data.name: Abdal
data.gender_notes: Abdal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to Allah and obedient to His commandments. Derived from the root word 'abd' which means 'servant'. The name Abdal carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abdal usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing complete submission and dedication to Allah.
data.etymology: Abdal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abdal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عبدال
in_arabic.long_meaning: عبدال هو اسم عربي يعود إلى الجذور العربية القديمة، مشتق من كلمة عبد، والتي تعني الخادم أو العبد، ويشير إلى العبد أو الخادم لله أو لرسوله، ويحمل هذا الاسم معنى روحيا عميقا في الإسلام، حيث يرمز إلى التواضع والخضوع لله

in_urdu.name: عبدال
in_urdu.long_meaning: عبدال ایک عربی نام ہے جو قدیم عرب کی جڑوں سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے، جو کہ عبد سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خادم یا بندہ، اور یہ اللہ یا اس کے رسول کے بندے یا خادم کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلام میں روحانی معنی رکھتا ہے، جہاں یہ اللہ کے سامنے تواضع اور خضوع کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अब्दल
in_hindi.long_meaning: अब्दल एक अरबी नाम है जो प्राचीन अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जो कि अब्द से व्युत्पन्न है, जिसका अर्थ है सेवक या सेवक, और यह अल्लाह या उसके रसूल के सेवक या सेवक की ओर संकेत करता है, और यह नाम इस्लाम में गहरा आध्यात्मिक अर्थ रखता है, जहां यह अल्लाह के सामने विनम्रता और समर्पण का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है

in_english.name: Abdal
in_english.long_meaning: Abdal is an Arabic name derived from ancient Arabic roots, stemming from Abd, meaning servant or slave, and refers to the servant or attendant of God or His prophet, and this name holds deep spiritual significance in Islam, symbolizing humility and submission before God

data.cultural_impact: The name Abdal holds a significant place in Islamic culture. The term is often used to refer to the Sufis, the mystics of Islam. Sufism is a mystical-ascetic dimension of Islam, emphasizing the interior dimensions of Islamic faith, including the deep love and devotion to Allah, self-emptying, and the striving for purity of the soul. The spiritual quest in Sufism is not just for personal salvation but for union with the divine. The term Abdal presents a public recognition to those who have pursued this spiritual quest and have attained excellence in their devotion and obedience to Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Abdal symbolizes a deep spiritual commitment and obedience to Allah. The term represents those individuals who have dedicated their lives to serving and drawing closer to Allah. By embracing the name, one acknowledges their role as a servant of Allah and strives to embody the virtues of patience, perseverance, and dedication. The significance of this name lies in its reminder of the ultimate goal of every human being, which is to draw closer to Allah and attain His pleasure.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Abdal carries profound spiritual symbolism as it is rooted in Quranic tradition. As a compound of 'Abd' (servant) and one of Allah's divine attributes, Abdal symbolizes complete submission and devotion to the Creator. It represents the spiritual journey of servanthood and humility before Allah. The meaning "Servant of Allah" symbolizes One who is devoted to Allah and obedient to His commandments. Derived from the root word 'abd' which means 'servant'.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Abdal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of servant of allah.
